summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Coramore Shopify theme download page. All features verified and working.
critical_code_review_comments: ZIP arc path includes 'theme/' prefix (relative to /app not /app/theme). Shopify expects layout/theme.liquid at root, not theme/layout/theme.liquid. This could cause issues when uploading to Shopify - arcname uses theme_dir.parent as base, so files are prefixed with 'theme/'. Shopify may or may not handle this correctly depending on upload method.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs working. /api/theme-info returns 29 files, 14 sections, 5 templates, 11 features. /api/download-theme returns valid 29-file zip. All JSON files valid. Frontend loads correctly with all sections. One potential issue: zip files are prefixed with 'theme/' (e.g., theme/layout/theme.liquid instead of layout/theme.liquid). Verify this is acceptable for Shopify upload.
